# slack Provider



## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "slack" {
  # The token defaults to the SLACK_TOKEN environment variable.
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `token` (String, Sensitive) Slack API token. Can also be set with the `SLACK_TOKEN` environment variable.
